title: Revocation of Transfer and Choice Placements
content:
## Policy

Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a transfer or choice placement may be revoked by the campus principal in either of these cases:
- in one semester the student reaches the type's unexcused-absence threshold or its tardy threshold (a threshold of 0 means the placement is not revocable on that ground);
- the student is placed in a disciplinary alternative education program, and the type allows revocation on such a placement.

A revocation takes effect only at the end of the current semester, and only when that date is no earlier than the type's notice period after the campus issues the written revocation notice. The notice period is counted in calendar days with the notice date as day 0. When the semester ends sooner, the revocation takes effect at the end of the following semester.

On revocation the student returns to the zoned campus on Attendance Zone Enrollment, the revocation's effective date is recorded on the enrollment, the transfer request's status becomes revoked, and the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account moves to the zoned campus. The family may file a new request in a later window.

Attendance Zone Enrollment and Pre-Kindergarten enrollments are never revoked under this policy.

The thresholds and notice period of each type are set in the district's attendance and discipline threshold table.

## Effective date with a 10-day notice period (hypothetical dates)

| Written notice issued | Earliest date allowed (day 10) | Current semester ends | Revocation takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 December | 15 December | 19 December | 19 December, the end of the current semester |
| 9 December | 19 December | 19 December | 19 December; the semester end falls exactly on day 10, which is no earlier than the notice period |
| 12 December | 22 December | 19 December | end of the following semester; the current semester ends sooner |

## Points of judgement

- Revocation is at the principal's discretion ("may be revoked"); reaching a threshold makes a placement revocable, and the revocation still takes effect only at a semester end.
- A Choice Program Enrollment placement is not revocable for tardies, because its tardy threshold is 0.
